T: He split the beer atom. Pass the bubbles.
D: A Tasmanian apple farmer's son splits the beer atom and invents rock and roll.
P: Serve the drinks when Einstein puts the bubbles into beer.
S: the family apple orchard in Tasmania

Paper-thin apple slices dusted with cinnamon sugar and dried slowly until crisp, with a whipped honey and vanilla yoghurt dip. Core 4 crisp apples and slice 2mm thin on a mandoline. Toss with the juice of 1 lemon, then 2 tbsp caster sugar mixed with 1 tsp cinnamon. Lay in a single layer on lined trays and bake at 110C for about 2 hours, turning once, until dry. Cool on the trays so they crisp. Stir 200g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp honey and half a tsp vanilla to dip.
Albert's Tasmanian home, beer with bubbles

Thick-cut potato chips dipped in a light beer batter and fried crunchy and golden, tossed in chicken salt with aioli on the side. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and parboil 5 minutes, then drain and steam dry 10 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour with 250ml cold beer and a pinch of salt. Dip the chips in the batter and fry in batches at 180C for 5 minutes until golden. Drain and toss with chicken salt. Mix 100g mayonnaise with 1 crushed garlic clove and lemon juice for dipping.

Scallops in a curry cream sauce with onion, in shortcrust pastry with a puff lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes.
M: Pork chops browned, then simmered with apple cider, apples, onion and sage for 20 minutes. Mash.
fish in a batter made with the beer he put bubbles in

Flathead in an extra-crisp beer and rice flour batter with chunky chips, lemon and a tartare sauce full of capers and gherkins. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, fry at 140C for 6 minutes, then 190C for 3 minutes. Whisk 120g plain flour, 60g rice flour, 1 tsp baking powder and salt with 300ml ice-cold beer until just combined. Dust 4 flathead fillets in flour, dip and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp. Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped gherkins, capers, parsley and lemon juice. Serve with lemon wedges.
W: Granny Smiths with sugar and cinnamon in a double crust, baked at 190C for 50 minutes. Cream.

Half crisp Australian lager and half cloudy Tasmanian apple cider poured into chilled pint glasses, with a dash of blackcurrant cordial at the bottom. Chill 4 pint glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Add 10ml blackcurrant cordial to each glass. Pour in 250ml cold apple cider down the side, then top slowly with 250ml cold lager so it layers and foams. Serve straight away. Totals are 1L cider and 1L lager.

s.how: Soften a diced onion in butter, add 1 tsp curry powder and 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Stir in 300g scallops off the heat and cool. Line patty tins with 2 sheets shortcrust, fill, top with 2 sheets puff and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

m.how: Brown 4 pork chops and set aside. Soften a sliced onion and 2 sliced apples with sage. Pour in 375ml apple cider, return the chops and simmer 20 minutes until the sauce reduces. Serve over 1kg potatoes mashed with butter.

w.how: Toss 1kg sliced Granny Smiths with 120g sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and cover with 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve warm with 300ml cream.
